ui_bugs.issue: React hydration warnings: <span data-ve-dynamic> wrappers rendered directly as child of <tbody> (and around <tr>), producing invalid HTML. Origin appears to be the visual-edit runtime wrapping mapped rows. Not breaking rendering but pollutes console with 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <tbody>' / '<tr> span' warnings.

action_items: (Optional/low) Fix hydration warnings caused by <span data-ve-dynamic='true'> being rendered as a direct child of <tbody> and around <tr>. Consider rendering the wrapper as React.Fragment or applying it outside of table rows.
(Cosmetic) Consider hiding sidebar 'Promessas' for COLLECTIONS_AGENT only if intentional — currently it's hidden. If Collections agents should register promises, expose the item.
critical_code_review_comments: routes.py upload_import: on parser exception the import doc is marked FAILED but the previously saved original file is left on disk (small storage leak). Consider unlinking on FAILED/REJECTED terminal states.

import_service.process_overdue_balances_import compares against last IMPORTED total_overdue only; if there is no prior imported record, no gating happens — that's OK for bootstrap but should be logged.
routes.py list_promises always sorts by promise_date asc; consider adding sort direction / date range filters for UX at scale.
routes.py list_imports has limit up to 200 but no offset/pagination — will grow unbounded once daily imports accumulate.
